title: Bleach Creator Returns With Closer Look at New Characters Revealed in Anime Finale
content:
More than 22 years after the anime debut, Bleach has finally reached its conclusion with the fourth part of the Thousand-Year Blood War Arc. As one of the most iconic Shonen Jump series of all time, the series took longer than expected to adapt the entire manga, but the wait was more than worth it. The anime released its final part in July this year as part of the Summer 2026 lineup and reached its conclusion after a major delay. As part of the Shonen Big Three alongside One Piece and Naruto, Bleach has always been celebrated as one of the most beloved Shonen Jump anime and manga franchises of all time.

However, despite the franchise’s popularity and the manga ending, it took Pierrot around a decade to return with a sequel to adapt the Thousand-Year Blood War Arc . The final arc of the main story was split into four parts, and it returned with far better quality animation, pacing, and original scenes. Tite Kubo, the manga creator, was heavily invested in the production by providing original character designs and storyboards for the anime’s final arc. The anime briefly introduced two new characters in the finale as well, whose information was shared by the creator along with the finale broadcast.

Bleach Creator Shares Information on Two Original Characters

The official X handle of Tite Kubo shared the character designs and concept sketches of Chad’s trainer and opponent for the finale. The update was shared around the same time as the finale broadcast . Introducing new but minor characters in the anime isn’t new in the TYBW arc, and Kubo is responsible for all of them. The sketches shared by the official handle are also drawn by the creator. The new designs may not be about characters with major roles in the story, but they help add more depth to Chad’s character. In the finale, Chad is introduced as a professional boxer, which is why these background characters are crucial to his backstory. Interestingly enough, his opponent shares a hilarious resemblance to a bald Yhwach.

What’s Next for Bleach After Anime Finale?

While the anime has already reached its conclusion, this doesn’t mean the end of the franchise. Studio Pierrot also needs to adapt the one-shot Kubo released in 2021 as part of the manga’s 20th anniversary. Titled No Breathes From Hell , the one-shot manga opened room for the story’s expansion, as it shed more light on Ichigo’s future and those around him. However, even if the manga didn’t expand the story completely with a longer run, there’s still a high possibility that the one-shot will be adapted into an anime, which will be just as exciting. Additionally, Bleach will be holding a panel on the Jump Studio stage of Jump Festa 2027. The convention will be held on December 19th and 20th, 2026, where we can expect major announcements from most of the Shonen Jump hits. This also includes Bleach since it’s guaranteed to drop information on its upcoming projects, although the details won’t be announced before the convention.

title: Solo Leveling’s New Story Brings Back Jinwoo’s Most Tragic Ally
content:
Warning: This article contains spoilers from the Solo Leveling webtoon! While the upcoming Solo Leveling movie has yet to share information on its release window, the action role-playing game continues to drop brand new content for fans. The second season of the anime ended after adapting the Jeju Island Arc, one of the most beloved parts of the story. However, now that Jinwoo’s true powers are known to everyone in the world, things will only continue to get more intense from here on out. The anime wrapped up its second season in March last year, but it has yet to return with a new sequel.

On the other hand, Solo Leveling: Arise , the action role-playing game developed by Netmarble, continues to introduce new and original characters from the main story. While a lot of the playable characters are unique to the game, many more are based on the original story by Chugong. The game also expands on their backstories that were never included in the main story, which makes it all the more interesting. The official website has a dedicated page called Hunter Origin that shares those backstories in the form of a one-shot webtoon series, and the latest one centers around Go Gunhee, the Chairman of the Korean Hunters Association, who met a tragic end.

Solo Leveling: Arise Reveals a Brand New Backstory of Go Gunhee

Go Gunhee plays a crucial role in the main story as the Chairman and also one of Jinwoo’s closest allies. As an S-Rank Hunter , he also acts as a political and moral anchor to stop Hunters from abusing their powers. He is one of the few characters who recognized Jinwoo’s potential early on and supported him throughout the story. However, while Gunhee was one of the major characters of the story, his past was only ever briefly mentioned. Hunter Origin finally explains it in detail, starting from his childhood to his old age when he awakened as a Hunter and got a stronger body, just like a young man.

It also reveals how the ghosts of those he failed to protect have been following him throughout these years. Being a Hunter is a rewarding job, but the death toll is far greater than anything else. In order to not only protect the innocent citizens who are victims of dungeon breaks, but also the Hunters who raid those dungeons, Gunhee established the Korean Hunters Association. He used his money and influence to save as many lives as possible, which is one of the reasons why Jinwoo held such deep respect for him. However, after living a life of helping others, Gunhee met a tragic end at the hands of the Monarchs. Despite his powers, Jinwoo was unable to save him, which remained one of his biggest regrets in life.

What Will Happen in Solo Leveling Movie?

While the movie hasn’t shared any details regarding its release, it shared a concept video and a key visual in July this year at the time of its official announcement. This is the first feature-length movie of the anime , which will continue the story from where the second season left off. The anime wrapped up its latest season with a huge cliffhanger by introducing two Monarchs who are planning to cause chaos in the world. Not only that, but Things have taken a drastic turn after the Jeju Island Arc, now that the entire world is aware of what Jinwoo is truly capable of. Guilds from around the world are looking to recruit him, but there’s no doubt Jinwoo has plans of his own. We can expect the upcoming movie to adapt the Recruitment Arc and Ahjin Guild Arcs from the main story. Depending on the pacing and the runtime, we might even get a glimpse at the Double Dungeon Arc, which is a major turning point in the series.

What are your expectations for the upcoming Solo Leveling movie? And are you looking forward to seeing more from Go Gunhee in the future? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

title: Rin Suzukawa's Outsider Paradise Manga Switches Publishers to Kadokawa, Gets Full Color Continuation
content:
Rin Suzukawa announced on her X/Twitter account on Wednesday that her Outsider Paradise has switched publishers from Futabasha to Kadokawa . The manga moved from Futabasha 's Manga Action magazine to Kadokawa 's KadoComi website. The manga will have black-and-white art until the 18th chapter, but will be in full color beginning with the 19th chapter.

The first three chapters are available on KadoComi now. The end of the first chapter also noted that Kadokawa will release digital versions of the manga's two compiled book volumes in early 2027, and that the second volume will contain an extra chapter in full color. Suzukawa is currently planning the full color chapters, and plans to introduce a story where the girls are "a little more grown up."

The manga has been on hiatus since the manga's 18th chapter in 2024 due to Suzukawa's poor health.

The manga centers on five eccentric girls in an art club, who have all been friends since the first year of middle school. The story is related to Suzukawa's earlier Asobi Asobase manga, with the art club the characters belong to being the same art club in the earlier manga.

Suzukawa launched the manga in Manga Action in May 2023. Futabasha published the manga's second volume in April 2024.

Suzukawa launched the Asobi Asobase (Play and Let Play) manga on Hakusensha 's Young Animal Densi manga website in 2015, but moved it to the main Young Animal magazine in November 2016. The manga ended in November 2022. U.S.-based localization company Comikey Media Inc. began digitally publishing the manga in English in September 2021. Dark Horse Comics also licensed the manga, and will release the first volume on November 17.

The manga's anime adaptation premiered in July 2018 and ran for 12 episodes. A separate anime on DVD shipped with the manga's seventh volume in December 2018.

Suzukawa launched the Galaxy Pū-chan Uchū no Hajikko de Konnichiwa (Galaxy Pū-chan: Hello from the Edge of the Universe) full-color manga on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app on January 4. Shogakukan published the manga's first volume on July 17.

title: Monarch: Legacy of Monsters Season 3 Fate Revealed, And the MonsterVerse May Not Be the Same
content:
The MonsterVerse has become a popular shared universe franchise running alongside the likes of Marvel and DC. Having started back in 2014 with the Godzilla reboot film , the MonsterVerse expanded into two separate film franchises focused on Godzilla and Kong, before bringing the two iconic Kaiju (or “Titans”) together for the 2021 crossover film, Godzilla vs. Kong . That crossover is on its way to being an entire trilogy (when Godzilla x Kong: Supernova is released in March), while the MonsterVerse universe has successfully expanded into television via the Apple TV series Monarch: Legacy of Monsters .

Tracking the history of the titular scientific/military organization that researches (and, if need be, contains) the Titans scattered across Earth, Monarch has been embraced by both the MonsterVerse fandom and mainstream viewers attracted to the show’s sci-fi lore. However, the movie-sized budget for the show has kept it on the bubble between renewal and cancellation, and fans have been left hanging for months now, wondering if the show will continue into Season 3 .

Now, we know.

Monarch: Legacy of Monsters Season 3 Will Be A Different Kind of Show

Monarch: Legacy of Monsters has been confirmed to be returning for Season 3 – with a catch. Apparently, Season 3 will “take the show in a new direction, featuring new Titans from Legendary’s Monsterverse.”

A whole new creative team is being brought in to replace showrunner/executive producer Chris Black and the writing team. No specific details on whether producers like comic book writer Matt Fraction ( Hawkeye ) are still involved. Executive producers on previous seasons include Joby Harold and Tory Tunnell from Safehouse Pictures; Hiro Matsuoka and Takemasa Arita from Toho, Chris Black, Jen Roskind, Matt Shakman ( Fantastic Four: First Steps ), Lawrence Trilling, and Andrew Colville.

In the first two seasons of Monarch , we met Cate Randa (S h ogun’s Anna Sawai), the granddaughter of Bill Randa (John Goodman / Anders Holm), the founder of Monarch, who died discovering Kong and his home turf, Skull Island . Cate was a schoolteacher directly affected (and traumatized) by the events of Godzilla’s emergence on “G-Day.” As Cate gets drawn back into Monarch when her father, Hiroshi, vanishes, Bill Randa’s research leads them on a global hunt that leads to several Titan encounters, with Godzilla, Kong, and several other Titans from Toho lore .

However, the series’ biggest sci-fi twist was revealed near the end of Season 1, within the flashback storyline about Bill’s early days founding Monarch with his colleagues Dr. Keiko Miura (Mari Yamamoto), Hiroshi’s mother, and Col. Lee Shaw (played by both Kurt and Wyatt Russell), the first military liaison to Monarch.

Bill, Keiko, and Lee were the first to uncover the Hollow Earth theory that explains where the Titans live and how they move across Earth. Part of that discovery was learning about “Axis Mundi,” the junction point between Earth’s surface and Hollow Earth, which the Titans use as a Waystation moving between worlds. Both Lee Shaw and Keiko Miura end up stranded in Axis Mundi – only to learn that the realm experiences extreme time distillation : hours in the strange realm equal years on Earth. When Lee and Keiko each return to the surface world, they find that decades have passed, Monarch has thrived, but their lives as they knew them have passed by.

Monarch has always been filling in the backstory of the MonsterVerse movies; Season 2 ended by setting up teases for events of Godzilla vs. Kong , like Apex Cybernetics obtaining the necessary algorithms and data that will allow them to build Mechagodzilla. It’ll be interesting to see if Season 3 abandons the backfilling approach as one of its changes, and what new concept the show explores instead.

Monarch “Classic” Will Still Continue

For longtime fans of Monarch , fear not: the original concept for the series will still continue on into an upcoming spinoff miniseries, Birdwatcher , centered around Wyatt Russell’s Lee Shaw. It will explore a mission Shaw takes on after returning from Axis Mundi (1962-1982). With the Cold War fully in swing by 1984, Monarch learns that the Soviets are hiding a Titan as a potential WMD, and Col. Shaw sets out to deal with the issue. The series will also feature Millie Brady, Pilou Asbaek, Corey Stoll, Ralph Ineson, Nyasha Hatendi, Connie Nielsen and Stana Katic.

Both Monarch: Legacy of Monsters Season 3 and Birdwatcher are in development with no confirmed premiere dates. You can stream the TV series on Apple TV; MonsterVerse movies can be streamed on HBO Max. What changes are you hoping the franchise will make (if any)?

Via: Deadline

title: Shiretto Sugee koto Itteru Gal Manga Takes 4-5 Month Break
content:
Taichi Matsuura and Otsuji 's Shiretto Sugee koto Itteru Gal ( Gals casually say incredible things. -The daily life of Paranormal High School- ) manga announced on Wednesday that the manga will go on hiatus and will return sometime in February or March next year. During its hiatus, the manga's illustrator Otsuji will draw special illustrations for the manga on its Tonari no Young Jump and Young Jump + pages.

The manga is based on Plott 's short web anime channel Shiritsu Paranormal Kōkō (Paranormal High School), and follows two high school gyaru Mirai Misato and "Heeko" Taira. Though Mirai has the power to see the future, and Heeko has the power to travel between parallel universes, they live a normal high school life, only occasionally saying the strangest things.

Matsuura and Otsuji launched the manga in Shueisha 's Tonari no Young Jump and Young Jump + services in November 2023. Shueisha published the manga's fifth compiled book volume on March 18, and will release the sixth volume on November 18.

Otsuji launched the My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked ( Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi ) manga in Ichijinsha 's Comic POOL digital manga magazine in November 2020. Ichijinsha published the manga's 10th volume on August 25. Seven Seas publishes the manga in English, and released the eighth volume in English on June 23. The manga inspired a television anime that debuted on July 8. REMOW 's "It's Anime" free anime YouTube channel streamed the series.
author: ANN

The manga inspired a television anime that debuted on July 8. REMOW 's "It's Anime" free anime YouTube channel streamed the series.

title: Shōta Kōno Launches Nightmare of Oveja Negra Manga
content:
Shōta Kōno launched a new manga titled Nightmare of Oveja Negra ( Oveja Negra-gou no Akumu ) simultaneously on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ platform and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus platform on Tuesday (Wednesday in Japan).

MANGA Plus publishes the science fiction horror series in English and describes the story:

The spacecraft Oveja Negra, which collects and sells space junk, was operating in the red again today. And Captain Hank was up to his eyeballs in debt. Then, one of the crew members Yuki picks up a mysterious distress signal and they discover an old, abandoned mining plant. Keen to salvage resources, Hank and his crew step inside the plant, but soon realize that something abnormal is happening there…

The series won the grand prize of the Shonen Jump+ Rensai Grand Prix 2025.

title: Star Trek, X-Men Actor Patrick Stewart Dies at 86
content:
Stewart was born in Mirfield in the West Riding of Yorkshire on July 13, 1940.

Stewart had many roles, but he was perhaps best known for playing Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation and later Star Trek: Picard . He played Professor Charles Xavier in Fox's X-Men films, as well as in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. He will appear again in Marvel's upcoming Avengers: Doomsday movie on December 18.

His roles also include Avery Bullock in American Dad , Captain Ahab in Moby Dick , Ebenezer Scrooge in A Christmas Carol , King Henry II in The Lion in Winter , Sir Ritchfield in The Sheep Detectives , Poop in The Emoji Movie , and Adventure in The Pagemaster . He also had numerous stage roles on Broadway. He won and was nominated for multiple awards throughout his life. He was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 2010.

Stewart also played Lord Yupa in Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind and Lloyd Steam in Steamboy . He voiced Zobek in the Castlevania : Lords of Shadow game.

title: Hotel Inhumans Anime's 2nd Season Casts Mitsuki Saiga
content:
The official website for the television anime of Ao Tajima 's Hotel Inhumans manga revealed on Thursday a new cast member for the anime's second season . Mitsuki Saiga plays Sekiya, a woman who is frequently seen on the train reading books about murder or poison:

The new season features returning staff, including director Tetsuro Amino at studio Bridge , and Bridge 's Isle studio (which Bridge established as a subsidiary in May 2025) is also credited for production. Shoji Yonemura ( Parasyte -the maxim- , Wave, Listen to Me! , Shaman King 2021) is again in charge of the series scripts, and Shingo Fujisaki ( Let This Grieving Soul Retire! ) is again designing the characters. Haru Yamada returns as the sound director and Koharu ( Charan-Po-Rantan ) is again composing the music.

GAN ( Takanori Iwata ) performs the second season's opening theme song "Rasen" (Spiral), and girl group Phantom Siita perform the ending theme song "Sweet Pea."

Hina Yomiya voices the new character Shiba Kirihara. Shōya Chiba plays the new character Subaru Yoda.

The first season debuted on TV Tokyo and its affiliates in July 2025, and ended in September that same year. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired.

The anime stars Yūsuke Kobayashi as Ikurō Hoshi and Hinano Shirahama as Sara Haizaki.

Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing the manga. The company describes the story:

A luxury hotel is required to offer certain amenities. First-rate food, sublime comforts, enchanting entertainment, and...the latest weapons, forged IDs, and body disposal service?! This is a hotel where the guests are professional assassins and its concierges never say no to any request. No matter what their dangerous guests need, the hotel staff are at their service!

Tajima launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Sunday Webry site in June 2021. The manga ended with its 12th compiled book volume, which shipped in September 2025.

title: Future Trunks Deserves a Bigger Role in Dragon Ball’s Anime Future
content:
Before the Marvel Cinematic Universe became a trend, Dragon Ball Z became one of the forefathers of expanded universes, giving its fans the OG time traveling hero , Future Trunks. The introduction to him came just a few episodes after the Frieza saga and hadn’t revealed the full picture of Vegeta and Bulma’s relation to him. The young Saiyan warrior quickly makes his presence known by taking down two of the most-feared aliens in the world with ease.

Future Trunks shreds Frieza and then blows up King Cold without breaking much of a sweat. A task that seemed insane considering how difficult Frieza was to defeat for Goku just a few episodes earlier. However, the blend of his parents is obvious. He’s revealed to be a more compassionate character like his mother, as noted by his care for the future of the planet but also is a confident but not nearly as cocky fighter like Vegeta. This blend made for a great protagonist and Dragon Ball Z ‘s own version of The Terminator franchise’s Kyle Reese. He just needs to be around way more.

Alternate Timeline Trunks Disappears With No Trace

Future Trunks and the Z Fighters trained up for the challenge at hand, and although Cell proved a worthy opponent, they eventually triumphed. As quickly as this powerful, futuristic friend came into the picture, he left and didn’t return for nearly a quarter century. A disappointing turn of events for a character that had become beloved by lots of fans. His development and work with Vegeta helped shape his father into the person he’s become in the current timeline.

Furthermore, Future Trunks’ exploits in the battlefield likely would’ve come in handy against some of the foes they face. Still, creator Akira Toriyama didn’t sideline the character forever. As is the way lots of times with Dragon Ball , a nostalgic part of history is destined to return. Future Trunks returns in the non-canon film, Broly – The Legendary Super Saiyan and helps the team of Saiyans defeat the manical Broly . He then made his canon return almost a quarter century later in Dragon Ball Super .

His character didn’t change much over the course of that time. He’s still just as serious and concerned for the future of the world as he was originally in the Cell Saga. He got to witness the death and destruction that Goku Black caused as well. He’s quite the traumatized man, but his resiliency is also what makes him a great character. Future Trunks is almost the pessimistic version of Goku in a lot of ways. Goku is the impossible optimist, but always looking to improve. Whereas Trunks looks for the bleak in situations and trains out of a fear of failure.

Future Trunks finally gets the peaceful, happy ending he deserved for so long, and he gets to deal the winning blow in the fight against Zamasu. He splits fused Zamasu right down the middle to end the physical threat of the monster. While winning the fight, Trunks states that they won’t let him win, which is a moment where he finally seems to see an encouraging light at the end of the tunnel. Although his life is now at peace and not in constant war, everyone knows the Z Fighters don’t laze around waiting for the next fight. Furthermore, Future Trunks went from a tragic tale and turned into a positive one. His story deserves to continue getting told.

What Does The Future Hold For Future Trunks?

The character is clearly not going anywhere. He came back in the non-canon Super Dragon Ball Heroes as Xeno Trunks, but much like the non-canon appearance in the Broly film, it doesn’t mean his story is continuing in the real timeline. However, these small fan service moments mean they’re going to keep him in the public’s consciousness.

His storyline didn’t receive the overall feelgood ending that the rest of the real timeline got, but it’s a gritty story that feels more like real life. It took a long time for Future Trunks to achieve a life that wasn’t wrought with death, so it should get a deeper run. What do you think? Should Future Trunks continue to get more storylines in other series? Let us know in the comments.
